Small deeds.Deed: **Hold your own.** Win a melee exchange as the defender against a fighter with a higher Fight
**Bring them home.** Carry a downed ally to the evac point, or off the table
**Dead eye.** Put down an enemy with a shot from beyond short range
**Tape and prayer.** Patch up two different allies in one battle
**Open sesame.** Prompt two different machines successfully in one battle
**Last to leave.** Be the last of your crew on the table, standing, when the battle ends
**Rude gesture.** Assist an ally while in base contact with an enemy
**Pocket it.** Pick up an item while in base contact with an enemy, and end the same activation out of contact with every enemy

Big deeds.Deed: **The hammer falls.** Win a melee exchange by 6 or more
Big deeds.Legend: **Heavy hands** ("the Hammer"): your Press may push the loser 2 inches and knock them prone

Big deeds.Deed: **Two for one.** Put down two enemies in a single activation
Big deeds.Legend: **Double tap** ("Two-Shot"): your second attack in an activation takes no -1 die (you still lose the reaction)

Big deeds.Deed: **Tin-opener.** Put down an enemy in a military frame
Big deeds.Legend: **Tin-opener** (same title): armour saves against your hits need 1 more

Big deeds.Deed: **Talk to the wall.** Prompt a Hard (10) target successfully and be standing at the end
Big deeds.Legend: **Old words** ("the Whisperer"): +1 die on prompts against turrets and rogue machines

Big deeds.Deed: **Cheek.** End a round in base contact with the enemy captain, with no lasting condition
Big deeds.Legend: **Unscathed** (same title): when you take a solid consequence, you may spend your reaction to read it as a glance

Big deeds.Deed: **Three for three.** Ask the voice three times in one battle and end it on your feet
Big deeds.Legend: **Hears voices** ("the Listener"): when an ally within 6 inches Asks the voice and gets a good result, you gain the same result too

Big deeds.Deed: **Bag the captain.** Capture the enemy captain
Big deeds.Legend: **Ransom note** ("the Sack"): for a captive you took, your crew may name a price up to double the usual (at most 60 parts)

Big deeds.Deed: **The getaway.** Leave by evac carrying a downed ally, with an enemy within 3 inches of you as you go
Big deeds.Legend: **Getaway** ("the Driver"): an evac you call does not scatter

Legendary deeds.Deed: **Twelve.** Put down an enemy with a shot whose total was exactly 12
Legendary deeds.Legend: **Dead centre** ("Dead-Centre"): your crushing shots (11 or more) cannot be saved

Legendary deeds.Deed: **The giant on the ground.** Win a melee exchange by 6 or more against the enemy fighter with the most Experience
Legendary deeds.Legend: **Giant-killer** (same title): +1 die in melee against any fighter with more Experience than you

Legendary deeds.Deed: **The grenade at the monster.** Hit a monster with a thrown grenade from beyond 3 inches, as the only one of your crew within 6 inches of it
Legendary deeds.Legend: **Mad bomber** ("the Bomber"): your grenades scatter 2 inches less (never below 0)

Legendary deeds.Deed: **Won't stay down.** Be stood back up after going down, and put down an enemy before the battle ends
Legendary deeds.Legend: **Won't stay down** ("the Cockroach"): when you go down, roll a d6; on 5 or 6 you are only prone and **Flustered** instead

Legendary deeds.Deed: **The last of the line.** Be the last fighter of your crew on your feet, and put down an enemy after the rest have gone down
Legendary deeds.Legend: **Last stand** ("the Last"): each time you would go down, first take one free action (an attack or a Move)

Legendary deeds.Deed: **One against five.** Win a melee exchange while three or more enemies are in base contact with you
Legendary deeds.Legend: **The wall** ("the Wall"): enemies gain no outnumbering dice against you

Legendary deeds.Deed: **The pod is mine.** Crack open a pod while an enemy is in base contact with you
Legendary deeds.Legend: **Sky's favourite** ("the Favourite"): when you crack a pod, roll twice on the drop table and choose

Legendary deeds.Deed: **The prayer answered.** Ask the voice, get a 6, and put down an enemy with the roll you asked it for
Legendary deeds.Legend: **Chosen** ("the Chosen"): when you Ask the voice, a 5 counts as a 6
